findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - accepting remaining findings with `forge close <item> --resolve accept --reason ...`.
This path still publishes at close.py:156, then continues to this final push. Accepted findings have blocking spotted entries; `spotted.record()` (src/forge/spotted.py:262–268) closes those entries, causing close.py:421–422 to commit another change. The invocation therefore successfully updates the existing pull request's branch twice, restarting CI and leaving the requested single-publication behavior incomplete. Defer the acceptance path's early push until the final bookkeeping is saved, and cover acceptance in the publication-count test.
